title: qPilot

author.name: ShivaTeja05
author.field: Molecular biology: relative gene-expression analysis by quantitative PCR (qPCR / RT-qPCR)

provenance.origin: github.com/ShivaTeja05/Qpilot at 3bbe2ddd02ce, personal (personal: "my lab" html in:readme archived:false (page 2))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Takes raw qPCR instrument curves to per-gene fold-change calls. The analysis stays blind until a person confirms the experimental design and the amplification calls. The tool then shows which analysis choices could flip each conclusion and keeps every decision in a hash-chained, exportable record. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
